args.body:
Hi David,

Welcome to Blue Sparrow Tech! My name is Emma Johnson, and I'm delighted to hear that you'll be joining our team in the marketing department next week.

I wanted to reach out personally to say hello and let you know how excited we are to have you on board. If you have any questions before your first day or need help settling in, please don't hesitate to reach out.

Looking forward to meeting you and working together!

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
